source_geometry_self_consistency.scope: source geometry, contacts and explicit opening hosts

agent_assumptions: No elevation or other floor is supplied: floor z=0 and ceiling height 3.0 m are explicit assumptions for the whole floor.
All door leaf heights assumed 2.1 m; all window sill/head assumed 0.9/2.7 m - no height evidence exists in the input.
Exterior wall thickness 240 mm read from double-line spacing (11 px); interior partitions drawn as ~5-6 px line pairs, nominal ~120 mm assumed.
Door operating states unknown; swing arcs give hinge side only.
Room roles (office/meeting/corridor) inferred from furniture; no text labels relied upon.
Plan spaces were compiled deterministically from the declared footprint and physical partition segments; no snapping, extension, clipping, or inferred partition was applied.
unresolved: Corridor junction corrected from saved unverified declaration: profile_001 on 1f_view.png shows the y957/969 wall ink only at x527-687 and x798-952 (plus end caps of the vertical corridor side walls at x692/698 and x789/796); the gap x~695-790 is a real opening with no separating wall, so P_corr_north_w was split into west (x513-695) and east (x792-975) portions and the open passage PASS_corr_s removed; the vertical corridor and bottom-wing corridor are one continuous source space.
Cyan window band W_N1 drawn as one continuous 8 m glazed band; any mullions within it were not resolved.
Interior partition faces measured from line pairs; exact thicknesses below drawing line width are uncertain.

Pixel-to-metre calibration cross-checked against the drawing's dimension chains: top (5000/4940/1120/3940/10000), left (3940/2060/4000/4120/1940/3940), bottom (5000/3640/4000/720/4000/3580/4060) and east office chain (7x2000) all agree with the anchor positions within ~2-3 px.

Recess north edge (ring x282-513) is declared on the wall centreline y582, not the outer face y588, so ring and partition share one representative plane; that footprint edge is ~0.13 m shallow, an accepted regularization.
No elevation or other floor is supplied: all opening heights remain assumptions; door D_lobby_west height assumed 2.1 m like the other doors.
East office strip dividers are drawn as ~5 px line pairs; declared y values may be ~2 px (0.05 m) from true centrelines.

Some door jamb marks are faint below the cyan profile threshold (e.g. D_M4 north jamb ~y790, D_O5 south jamb ~y755); doors were kept at their observed pair positions consistent with the uniform door rhythm.
Pixel-to-world calibration was supplied by the caller and was not independently verified.

scope.endpoint_selection: exact original image name and linked wall floor

limits: Endpoint pixels are the declared original-image evidence and are drawn without inferred movement.
Tangential range and normal displacement are conditional on the caller-supplied axis-aligned calibration.
A dimension extension-line tick may legitimately lie outside its linked finite wall segment; this is a spatial fact, not an error or correctness verdict.
This view does not inspect pixels, choose a host wall, or mutate source geometry or evidence.

current_claim_state.note: Current numerical/context consistency only; neither retained nor confirmed means drawing truth.

height_coverage.note: Coverage means a current adopted z binding, not proof that the drawing or BIM is correct. Inference and declared values do not count as located-image height evidence.
